description: This Java class implements a thread-safe cache for Comparable values, updating entries only when new values are greater or the key is new.

classes.name: ComparableCache
classes.description: A cache for storing Comparable values with conditional update logic based on value comparison.

methods.name: ComparableCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size and optional cache name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: updateIfNewOrGreater
methods.description: Updates the cache entry only if the new value is greater than the existing one or if the key is new.
